description: Supported, reversible gaming settings applied after Windows Setup. Each maps to a Windows Settings page and is captured before change so it can be restored exactly.

tweaks.title: Game Mode
tweaks.description: Prioritizes the game and pauses Windows Update restarts and notifications while playing.

tweaks.title: Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling
tweaks.description: Lets the GPU manage its own memory scheduling. Requires a supporting driver (AMD Adrenalin) and a restart.
tweaks.settingsPage: Settings > System > Display > Graphics > Advanced graphics settings

tweaks.title: Optimizations for windowed games
tweaks.description: Uses the flip presentation model for DirectX 10/11 windowed and borderless games, lowering latency and enabling Auto HDR and VRR.
tweaks.settingsPage: Settings > System > Display > Graphics > Optimizations for windowed games

tweaks.title: Variable refresh rate for games without native support
tweaks.description: Extends FreeSync/VRR to DirectX 11/12 games that don't support it natively. Requires a VRR-capable display.
tweaks.settingsPage: Settings > System > Display > Graphics > Variable refresh rate

tweaks.title: Turn off background recording
tweaks.description: Stops Game Bar from continuously recording the last minutes of gameplay. Manual captures (Win+Alt+R) still work.
tweaks.settingsPage: Settings > Gaming > Captures > Record what happened

tweaks.title: Turn off Enhance pointer precision
tweaks.description: Disables mouse acceleration for consistent aim. Personal preference; off by default in this catalog.
tweaks.settingsPage: Settings > Bluetooth & devices > Mouse > Additional mouse settings

neverChange.reason: AMD Ryzen X3D processors (such as the 7800X3D) rely on the Balanced plan with the AMD chipset driver; forcing High/Ultimate Performance can reduce gaming performance.
Required for Xbox mode and used by the AMD 3D V-Cache Performance Optimizer to detect games.
Security features; some anti-cheat systems require them. Never disabled for benchmarks.
Security; not altered for synthetic gains.
